notes: Seek: sub-decoder Seek (slot +0x0c) through the PCM or IMA class chosen by the format tag; -1 with no sub-decoder
Reset: sub-decoder Reset (slot +0x10) through the PCM or IMA class, then counters and pending list under the lock
Rewind: restores the older or newer saved state (PCM or IMA SetState by format tag), then base EmulateDecode for the remainder. IMA SetState is partial in its own slice
CreateTransitionRulesContainer: allocation extra + 36*count - 36, pointer always stored, count on success. Matches the pseudocode exactly
CreateSegmentsInfoContainers: allocation extra + 24*count - 24; count and one empty cue vector per segment on success
Decode: state swap and GetState on the second call or past capacity, pending state or base state 0, base Decode, frame counters. IMA GetState is partial in its own slice
~DecoderNativeCursor (D1): sub-decoder, two states and playlist manager destroyed in the original order. Playlist manager dtor is partial in the playlists slice
D0 deleting destructor, compiler-generated; wraps D1 (0x872314)
~DecoderNative (D1): frees segment, rule and state arrays; the members (cue table, transitions, state map, playlist manager) follow in the original order
D0 deleting destructor, compiler-generated; wraps D1 (0x872550)
CreatePlaylistsContainer: Init reproduced; return value approximated by IsValid() because NativePlaylistsManager::Init returns void in the port
SetImplicitSegmentCues: body empty. Control flow traced: a cue vector of size 1 gets a 0 and then the same value pushed twice (LABEL_7 then LABEL_3), so the pseudocode is not resolved; left empty
ParseFile: rewinds, reads the 8-byte header and checks the VoxN magic; the chunk loop (Afmt, Segm, Cues, Grpe, Rule, Plst, Stat, end) is not ported, so returns false
DecoderNativeCursor C1: parses on the first cursor; sub-decoder creation (PCM 0x170 bytes, IMA 0x1c0 bytes, states 0x144 or 0x150), the playlist manager copy and the track parameters are not ported
DecoderNativeCursor C2: same body as C1 (0x8742f4), partial for the same reason
